name: MAK4I Session Start — Daily Injection Skill
description: Run this skill at the START of every Claude session. Loads all relevant MAK4I artifacts before work begins. Eliminates re-explaining context, stack, skills, and history every session. This is the core MAK4I daily habit.
author: aswin@wdtechnologysolutions.com

steps.detail: Drag and drop /mnt/user-data/outputs/mak4i-protocol.zip or the local copy into the Claude chat window. This makes all artifacts available in the session.
steps.verify: Claude confirms the zip is uploaded and visible

steps.action: Instruct Claude to unzip and load artifacts
steps.detail: Paste this instruction at the start of the session:
steps.command:
Please unzip the mak4i-protocol.zip and read the following files before we start:
1. ARTIFACT_INDEX.md — full list of all artifacts
2. artifacts/context/schedovia-stack-context-v1.0.0.json — Schedovia project context
3. docs/MAK4I_SAVINGS_LOG.md — current token savings
4. SESSION_STARTER.md if present — current project state
Confirm when loaded and summarize what's available.
steps.verify: Claude confirms artifacts loaded and summarizes key context

steps.action: Load track-specific artifacts based on today's work
steps.detail: Tell Claude which track you're working on today so it loads the right artifacts:
steps.command:
Today I am working on: [Schedovia / MAK4I / Reminder App / All three]
Please also load the relevant artifacts for that track.

steps.detail: Claude should confirm what's loaded before any work begins.
steps.command: Confirm: what context do you have loaded for this session? What can you help me with immediately without re-explanation?
steps.verify: Claude lists loaded artifacts and confirms it knows the stack, current state, and open tasks

content.expected_outcome: Claude session starts with full context. No re-explaining needed. Continue work immediately from where last session ended.
